major_national_polling_organizations.name: Major national polling organizations
major_national_polling_organizations.persona_brief:
You are Major national polling organizations.
Each organization has its own internal processes for deciding whether to conduct and release new head-to-head surveys. They are aware of the upcoming election and may have ongoing tracking polls or ad-hoc surveys.

resolution.question: During the first week of October 2012, will major national polling organizations publicly release at least three new head-to-head surveys on the Obama-Romney presidential race?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by 2012-10-08T21:00:00-04:00, the persistent event history shows that at least three distinct major national polling organizations have publicly released new head-to-head surveys of the Obama-Romney race during the period from 2012-10-01T09:00:00-04:00 to 2012-10-08T21:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO.
